name: Vạn Xuân (Early Lý dynasty)
alt: Nam Việt (the Lý Nam Đế page's name for the state)

predecessors.name: Liang dynasty
predecessors.text: Jiaozhou (Giao Châu): the Red River delta with Thanh Hóa and Nghệ An, the Liang province Lý Bí's rising took in 541–543

successors.name: Sui dynasty
successors.text: Jiaozhou, surrendered by Lý Phật Tử to Liu Fang's army in 602

ledger.x: 544: Lý Bí proclaims himself emperor of Vạn Xuân.
544: the Liang send an army to retake Jiaozhou.
548: Lý Bí hands power to his brother Lý Thiên Bảo; Triệu Quang Phục takes the throne in the delta.
550: the war with the Liang ends in Vạn Xuân's favour.
571: Lý Phật Tử defeats Triệu Việt Vương and reunites the state.
602: Lý Phật Tử surrenders to the Sui.

wars.name: Liang–Vạn Xuân war (544–550)
wars.outcome: The Liang army sent in October 544 took the capital in the winter of 545 and Gia Ninh in 546; Lý Bí died in 548; Triệu Quang Phục 'drove the Chinese out from Vạn Xuân in 550'.

wars.name: Sui conquest of Vạn Xuân (602)
wars.outcome: 'Emperor Wen of Sui ordered Liu Fang to invade with 100,000 troops.

certainty.note: The state is the Liang province of Jiaozhou; its northern limit follows the provincial frontier Cliopatria draws, its southern limit toward Lâm Ấp (Đức Châu, Hà Tĩnh) is approximate.
